name: john
title: John the Ripper
description: Password hash cracking with John the Ripper (bleeding-jumbo, CPU only): wordlist mode with rules (the bundled password.lst or your wordlist from /work), single crack and incremental mode, for a bounded time, with autodetected or chosen hash format; extract_hash turns protected zip, rar, PDF, Office, SSH key and KeePass files from /work into crackable hashes. No network.
license: MIT (MCP server, axross-mcp-hub) AND GPL-2.0-or-later with relaxed terms for components (John the Ripper jumbo; unRAR code under its own licence)

mounts.description: Optional: wordlists and protected files (read-only is enough)

notes: Crack only hashes you are authorized to crack. Hashes go to a private temporary file, never onto a command line; each run ends after max_seconds (at most 30 minutes), and the pot file is discarded with the run.
